grammar.pattern: 分钟 / 年 / 天 / 周
grammar.purpose: Distinguish a duration from a point in time
grammar.explanation: 分钟 measures elapsed minutes, not a clock reading: 等十分钟. 年、天、周 can measure durations: 学了两年、住三天、过一周再见. 七点 is seven o’clock; 七分钟 is seven minutes. 第十周年 marks ten completed years of an institution, while the plan below concerns one evening. Usually say 下周 or 一周以后, not 一个下周.

examples.zh: 我们等十分钟，七点开始。
examples.py: wǒ men děng shí fēn zhōng , qī diǎn kāi shǐ .
examples.en: We wait ten minutes; it starts at seven.

examples.zh: 他学了两年汉语，在这里住三天。
examples.py: tā xué le liǎng nián hàn yǔ , zài zhè lǐ zhù sān tiān .
examples.en: He has studied Chinese for two years and stays here for three days.

examples.zh: 一周以后再见，下周还有节目。
examples.py: yī zhōu yǐ hòu zài jiàn , xià zhōu hái yǒu jié mù .
examples.en: See you a week later; there is another programme next week.

commonMistakes.why: For a seven-minute duration, use 七分钟; 点 belongs to a clock time.

grammar.pattern: （在）…以前 / 以后 / 前 / 后
grammar.purpose: Anchor before and after to the actual event
grammar.explanation: 开场以前 and 开场前 both mean before the start; 散场以后 and 散场后 mean after the end. 在 can introduce the time phrase: 在开场前. 以前/以后 can also stand alone for formerly/later, so give an explicit anchor when timings matter. 六点半集合 is not a claim that the programme starts at six thirty.

examples.py: zài kāi chǎng qián , wǒ men xiān jiǎn piào .
examples.en: Before the show starts, we first have our tickets checked.

examples.zh: 开场以前先坐好，散场以后再出去。
examples.py: kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān zuò hǎo , sàn chǎng yǐ hòu zài chū qù .
examples.en: Take your seat before the start; leave after the end.

examples.zh: 散场后喝茶，回家前看有没有车。
examples.py: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá , huí jiā qián kàn yǒu méi yǒu chē .
examples.en: Have tea after the show; check transport before going home.

commonMistakes.wrong: 开场以后先检票，才可以入场。
commonMistakes.right: 开场以前先检票，才可以入场。
commonMistakes.why: In this plan, ticket checking precedes admission and the start.

grammar.pattern: 要 / 快要 / 就要 … 了
grammar.explanation: 要开始了、快要开始了、就要开始了 mark an approaching start. 了 belongs to the change construction, not a completed start. With a definite near time, 就要 is often natural: 明天就要开始了. 快要 generally describes imminence without a fixed future time directly before it. Compare 节目开始了 (already started) and 节目就要开始了 (about to start). Do not translate both as finished.

examples.py: jié mù yào kāi shǐ le .
examples.en: The programme is about to begin.

examples.zh: 快要七点了，节目就要开始了。
examples.py: kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
examples.en: It is nearly seven; the programme is about to begin.

examples.zh: 下周就要放假了，不是已经放假了。
examples.py: xià zhōu jiù yào fàng jià le , bù shì yǐ jīng fàng jià le .
examples.en: The holiday starts next week; it has not already begun.

commonMistakes.wrong: 节目就要开始了，所以已经结束了。
commonMistakes.right: 节目就要开始了，所以还没开始。
commonMistakes.why: About to start does not mean already ended.

dialogue.title: The changed meeting time
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the current meeting time and what stays the same.

lines.zh: 你刚到吗？我早晨看了通知，说六点半集合。
lines.py: nǐ gāng dào ma ? wǒ zǎo chén kàn le tōng zhī , shuō liù diǎn bàn jí hé .
lines.en: Did you just arrive? I read a notice this morning saying to meet at half past six.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先停一下。新通知刚刚发来，集合改成六点四十。
lines.py: xiān tíng yī xià . xīn tōng zhī gāng gāng fā lái , jí hé gǎi chéng liù diǎn sì shí .
lines.en: Wait. The new notice has just arrived; the meeting time changed to six forty.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 节目也改了吗？
lines.py: jié mù yě gǎi le ma ?
lines.en: Did the programme time change too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有，还是七点。开场以前先检票，六点四十集合就好。
lines.py: méi yǒu , hái shi qī diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , liù diǎn sì shí jí hé jiù hǎo .
lines.en: No, still seven. Tickets are checked before the start; meeting at six forty is fine.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我们有二十分钟。刚才收到的是什么？
lines.py: nà wǒ men yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng . gāng cái shōu dào de shì shén me ?
lines.en: Then we have twenty minutes. What did we receive just now?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 刚才是旧的。上周的图片也别当成今天的。
lines.py: gāng cái shì jiù de . shàng zhōu de tú piàn yě bié dàng chéng jīn tiān de .
lines.en: That was the old one. Do not treat last week’s image as today’s either.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这时灯还亮着，节目还没开始吧？
lines.py: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe , jié mù hái méi kāi shǐ ba ?
lines.en: The lights are still on now; it has not started yet, right?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，快要七点了。灯暗了以后先别走，节目就要开始了。
lines.py: duì , kuài yào qī diǎn le . dēng àn le yǐ hòu xiān bié zǒu , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .
lines.en: Right, nearly seven. Stay seated after the lights dim; the programme is about to begin.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 散场后喝茶？夜里还有车吗？
lines.py: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá ? yè lǐ hái yǒu chē ma ?
lines.en: Tea after the show? Will transport still be running at night?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先确认，别到半夜才问。不一会儿，另一位朋友也会到。
lines.py: xiān què rèn , bié dào bàn yè cái wèn . bù yí huìr , lìng yī wèi péng you yě huì dào .
lines.en: Check first; do not wait until midnight to ask. Another friend will arrive shortly too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 学校十周年，这个学期节目不少。下周还有？
lines.py: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī jié mù bù shǎo . xià zhōu hái yǒu ?
lines.en: It is the school’s tenth anniversary; quite a few programmes this term. Another next week?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有，不久以后再发通知。今天先看这一场。
lines.py: yǒu , bù jiǔ yǐ hòu zài fā tōng zhī . jīn tiān xiān kàn zhè yī chǎng .
lines.en: Yes, another notice will be sent before long. Today let us watch this one first.
lines.speaker: b

choices: The programme now starts at six forty

choices: Yes, every bus runs all night

reading.title: Current notice
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read to distinguish old information, durations and event anchors.

lines.zh: 早晨的通知写六点半集合。新通知刚刚改成六点四十，节目还是七点。
lines.py: zǎo chén de tōng zhī xiě liù diǎn bàn jí hé . xīn tōng zhī gāng gāng gǎi chéng liù diǎn sì shí , jié mù hái shi qī diǎn .
lines.en: The morning notice says to meet at six thirty. The new notice has just changed it to six forty; the programme still starts at seven.

lines.zh: 刚才收到的图片是旧的。后来我们才看到新消息，先停下来检查了一遍。
lines.py: gāng cái shōu dào de tú piàn shì jiù de . hòu lái wǒ men cái kàn dào xīn xiāo xī , xiān tíng xià lái jiǎn chá le yī biàn .
lines.en: The image received just now was old. We only saw the new message afterwards and stopped to check it.

lines.zh: 从六点四十到七点有二十分钟，不是二十点。开场以前先检票，再入场。
lines.py: cóng liù diǎn sì shí dào qī diǎn yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng , bù shì èr shí diǎn . kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān jiǎn piào , zài rù chǎng .
lines.en: There are twenty minutes from six forty to seven, not twenty o’clock. Have tickets checked before the start, then enter.

lines.zh: 这时灯还亮着。快要七点了，节目要开始了，但还没有开始。
lines.py: zhè shí dēng hái liàng zhe . kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù yào kāi shǐ le , dàn hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ .
lines.en: The lights are still on now. It is nearly seven and the programme is about to begin, but it has not started yet.

lines.zh: 灯暗了以后，先坐好。散场后再喝茶，回家前先确认夜里有没有车。
lines.py: dēng àn le yǐ hòu , xiān zuò hǎo . sàn chǎng hòu zài hē chá , huí jiā qián xiān què rèn yè lǐ yǒu méi yǒu chē .
lines.en: When the lights dim, stay seated. Have tea after the show and check night transport before going home.

lines.zh: 不一会儿，朋友也来了。我们没有等到半夜才问回家的办法。
lines.py: bù yí huìr , péng you yě lái le . wǒ men méi yǒu děng dào bàn yè cái wèn huí jiā de bàn fǎ .
lines.en: Our friend arrived in a little while too. We did not wait until the middle of the night to ask how to get home.

lines.zh: 学校十周年，这个学期每周都有活动。上周去过一次，下周还想再去。
lines.py: xué xiào shí zhōu nián , zhè gè xué qī měi zhōu dōu yǒu huó dòng . shàng zhōu qù guò yī cì , xià zhōu hái xiǎng zài qù .
lines.en: For the school’s tenth anniversary there is an activity every week this term. We went once last week and want to go again next week.

lines.zh: 不久以后会发下周的通知。今天这一张不能拿来确定下周的时间。
lines.py: bù jiǔ yǐ hòu huì fā xià zhōu de tōng zhī . jīn tiān zhè yī zhāng bù néng ná lái què dìng xià zhōu de shí jiān .
lines.en: Next week’s notice will be sent before long. Today’s notice cannot establish next week’s times.

questions.q: What should the reader rely on for today?
When is the programme due to start?
Does today’s notice prove next week’s time?
choices: No, next week needs its own notice
Yes, every activity has the same time
questions.answer: No, next week needs its own notice

lines.py: zǎo chén de tōng zhī xiě liù diǎn bàn jí hé . xīn tōng zhī gāng gāng gǎi chéng liù diǎn sì shí , jié mù hái shi qī diǎn .
lines.en: The morning notice says to meet at six thirty. The new notice has just changed it to six forty; the programme still starts at seven.

lines.py: dēng àn le yǐ hòu , xiān zuò hǎo . sàn chǎng hòu zài hē chá , huí jiā qián xiān què rèn yè lǐ yǒu méi yǒu chē .
lines.en: When the lights dim, stay seated. Have tea after the show and check night transport before going home.

extraReadings.title: Wait for the start
extraReadings.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
extraReadings.purpose: Read an original verse about a shared evening.

lines.zh: 刚到门口，先停一停。旧图放下，新消息看清。
lines.py: gāng dào mén kǒu , xiān tíng yī tíng . jiù tú fàng xià , xīn xiāo xī kàn qīng .
lines.en: Just at the door, pause a moment. Put down the old image; read the new message clearly.

lines.zh: 六点四十，一起集合。二十分钟以后，七点开场。
lines.py: liù diǎn sì shí , yì qǐ jí hé . èr shí fēn zhōng yǐ hòu , qī diǎn kāi chǎng .
lines.en: Meet together at six forty. Twenty minutes later, start at seven.

lines.zh: 开场前检票，灯暗后坐好。要开始了，不是已经散场。
lines.py: kāi chǎng qián jiǎn piào , dēng àn hòu zuò hǎo . yào kāi shǐ le , bù shì yǐ jīng sàn chǎng .
lines.en: Check tickets before the start; sit when the lights dim. About to begin does not mean already ended.

lines.zh: 散场后喝茶，回家前看车。不等半夜，才想办法。
lines.py: sàn chǎng hòu hē chá , huí jiā qián kàn chē . bù děng bàn yè , cái xiǎng bàn fǎ .
lines.en: Tea after the show; check transport before heading home. Do not leave planning until midnight.

lines.zh: 上周是上周，下周等通知。今天的时间，别送给明天。
lines.py: shàng zhōu shì shàng zhōu , xià zhōu děng tōng zhī . jīn tiān de shí jiān , bié sòng gěi míng tiān .
lines.en: Last week is last week; wait for next week’s notice. Do not give today’s times to tomorrow.

lines.zh: 一周又一周，朋友还会见。周年有节目，我们慢慢看。
lines.py: yī zhōu yòu yī zhōu , péng you hái huì jiàn . zhōu nián yǒu jié mù , wǒ men màn màn kàn .
lines.en: Week after week, we will meet friends again. Anniversary programmes: we can take our time watching.

choices: Their dates and times may differ
questions.answer: Their dates and times may differ

audio.zh: 节目就要开始了，还没有开始。
audio.py: jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le , hái méi yǒu kāi shǐ .
audio.en: The programme is about to begin and has not started yet.

tasks.why: 就要…了 describes the approaching change.

natural.zh: 集合改成六点四十，开场还是七点。

natural.en: The meeting time changed to six forty; the start is still seven.

pragmatics.note: State which time changed instead of implying both did.

pragmatics.note: Transport availability is not inferred from the performance notice.
